camel_example: aliyun hbr UpdateHanaInstance --region cn-hangzhou --InstanceNumber 0 --UseSsl true --ValidateCertificate false
kebab_example: aliyun hbr update-hana-instance --instance-number 0 --use-ssl true --validate-certificate false --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateHanaInstance

parameters.help_en: The ID of the backup vault
parameters.name: vault_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the SAP HANA instance
parameters.name: cluster_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the SAP HANA instance
parameters.name: hana_name

parameters.help_en: The private or internal IP address of the host where the primary node of the SAP HANA instance resides
parameters.help_zh: SAP HANA主节点的私有或内网IP地址
parameters.name: host

parameters.help_en: The instance number of the SAP HANA system
parameters.help_zh: 安装SAP HANA时指定的实例编号
parameters.name: instance_number

parameters.help_en: The username of the SYSTEMDB database
parameters.name: user_name

parameters.help_en: The password that is used to connect with the SAP HANA database
parameters.name: password

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to connect with the SAP HANA database over Secure Sockets Layer (SSL). Valid values:

true: The SAP HANA database is connected over SSL.
false: The SAP HANA database is not connected over SSL
parameters.help_zh:
是否打开SSL连接开关。

true：打开SSL连接开关，使用SSL安全连接方式连接数据库。
false：不打开SSL连接开关，使用普通方式连接数据库
parameters.name: use_ssl

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to verify the SSL certificate of the SAP HANA database. Valid values:

true: The SSL certificate of the SAP HANA database is verified.
false: The SSL certificate of the SAP HANA database is not verified
parameters.help_zh:
是否验证数据库服务端SSL证书。
true：验证
false：不验证
parameters.name: validate_certificate

parameters.help_en: The alert settings. Valid value: INHERITED, which indicates that the Cloud Backup client sends alert notifications by using the same method configured for the backup vault
parameters.help_zh: 告警设置。取值为INHERITED，表示使用与备份库一致的报警方式
parameters.name: alert_setting

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group
parameters.name: resource_group_id

Code.description_en: The response code. The status code 200 indicates that the request was successful

Message.description_en: The returned message. If the request was successful, "successful" is returned. If the request failed, an error message is returned
Message.description_zh: 返回信息描述，成功一般返回successful，错误时会返回相应错误信息

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request was successful. Valid values:

true
false
Success.description_zh:
请求是否成功。

true：成功
false：失败
